text: The **MGAP forest map 2021** classifies the 2025 loss area as **native forest**, covering **13.1 ha** of the **13.5 ha** detected by Hansen GFC. The remaining **0.4 ha** falls outside mapped forest areas. This source provides the territorial context but does not determine the cause or legality of the loss. The classification aligns with the **native forest context** of the asset, as confirmed by the JRC GFC2020 (98% agreement).
